errors.finding: All seven DataAction tools still point at PENDING_CREATE placeholder integration IDs; Sage create_version requires real Genesys Cloud data action UUIDs.
errors.evidence: Each DataAction target.id is PENDING_CREATE:mikedai_OSC_* (e.g. generate_security_code → PENDING_CREATE:mikedai_OSC_SecurityCodeGenerator). _meta notes org data-action cap (595/500) blocks creation until capacity is cleared.
errors.fix: After the author frees data-action capacity and creates the seven integrations from data-actions/*.json, replace each target.id with the org UUID (keep target.name) and re-run create_version. Design-only preflight (L5/L11/T8) already passes on type wiring.

warnings.finding: Global guidelines repeat the full verification collection and gating rules that already live on generate_security_code, verify_claim_identity, and validate_security_code.
warnings.evidence: instructions[5–10,14,23–24] mirror verify/validate inputInstructions and outputInstructions (collect last name + ZIP/DOB, one item at a time, no claim details before validate_security_code, voice code readback).
warnings.fix: Keep claim-existence and empathy rules in instructions[]; move field-order, formatting, and post-outcome wording exclusively into the verification tools to cut per-turn spec noise and reduce conflict risk (09d).

impact.reliability: Conflicting wording between global and tool-local rules

warnings.finding: Identity-attribute failures use neutral copy, but OTP validation failures use more specific wording that can feel like a code-specific rejection.
warnings.evidence: Instruction 9: neutral "I could not match those details." validate_security_code outputInstructions: "If outcome is failed, say the code did not match…"
warnings.fix: Rewrite validate_security_code failed branch to reuse the same neutral phrase as verify_claim_identity (or a single shared sentence in both tools), still without revealing which digit failed.

source.section: Guidelines — Do not put in Guidelines

warnings.finding: create_service_case asks the model to supply verification state as a free-form User enum instead of deriving it from typed verification outputs.
warnings.evidence: Input verification on create_service_case uses source User and type InputVerificationState (verified/unverified/failed/locked) alongside optional ToolOutput verificationToken.
warnings.fix: Prefer a backend-derived verification flag in the data action (from verificationToken or session), or add inputValidation tying verification=verified to a present VerificationResult mapping; avoid asking the model to self-report verification state for handoff summaries.

warnings.finding: Transfer sequencing (create_service_case then Escalation event only) is enforced in global prose, not by the type/event graph.
warnings.evidence: Instruction 20: "call create_service_case first, then your turn must be the Escalation event only." No tool output type gates the Escalation event.
warnings.fix: Keep instruction 20 but strengthen create_service_case outputInstructions; consider Architect-side transfer only after handoff.case_id is populated in OutputData. Document the pattern in runbook for demo flows.

source.section: Prose ordering instead of type ordering

warnings.finding: Several guidelines are labeled "On voice" but nothing ties them to ContextInteractionChannel from start context.
warnings.evidence: Instructions 22–24 apply voice brevity, digit spelling, and security-code phrasing globally; start context includes interaction_channel but no External wiring or conditional guidance.
warnings.fix: Add a short digital branch (e.g., when interaction_channel is not voice, allow slightly longer replies and typed code entry) in tool pre-instructions or a single channel-aware guideline.

warnings.finding: search_osc_knowledge reuses MikeD_KB_Config without confirming corpus scope matches this demo.
warnings.evidence: _meta.note and knowledge-sources.md: KB reuse pending author confirmation; local corpus is mikedai_OSC_GeneralKnowledge.md.
warnings.fix: Before publish, ensure MikeD_KB_Config includes the OSC demo cards (or upload via ensure_knowledge_source) and smoke-test general-timeline-question and fraud-text-message scenarios.

info.finding: Local ava-build preflight checks (L5 ToolOutput direction, L11 User named types, T8 outputs, T7 start context, N2 enums) pass with zero blocks on the current payload shape.
info.evidence: Automated scan of design-artifact.json found 0 blocking issues aside from PENDING_CREATE targets.
info.fix: No schema change needed before bind; re-run the same checks after editing targets.

info.finding: ClaimSummaryResult exposes many fields to the model, but get_claim_summary outputInstructions cap spoken answers to three points.
info.evidence: ClaimSummaryResult declares status, documents[], paymentState, mailingAddressMasked, etc.; outputInstructions limit user-facing content.
info.fix: Optional later trim of unused output properties in the data action contract if publish-time copy cost becomes noticeable (09a).

info.finding: Twenty authored scenarios and three test sets exist locally but all metadata.status values are NOT_RUN.
info.evidence: test-sets/osc-v1-scenarios.json (12 required personas), osc-v1-full.json (20), osc-v1-smoke.json (3); mock-plan.json is local-only.
info.fix: After org build and mock binding, run osc-v1-smoke then osc-v1-scenarios before demo sign-off.

info.finding: contact_reason and has_claim_id start-context hints are declared but never referenced in role or instructions.
info.evidence: InputData includes ContextContactReason and ContextHasClaimId; guidelines only mention first_name from start context.
info.fix: Optionally add one guideline to use contact_reason/has_claim_id to open the right branch without skipping own-vs-other inquiry.

positives.finding: Verification and claim access are structurally gated: SecurityCodeResult → verify_claim_identity → VerificationStartResult.sessionId → validate_security_code → VerificationResult.verificationToken → get_claim_summary / send_claim_notice.
positives.evidence: ToolOutput mappings on verify_claim_identity, validate_security_code, get_claim_summary, and send_claim_notice; undisclosed SecurityCodeValue, SessionIdValue, VerificationTokenValue types.
positives.fix: Preserve this graph when editing contracts; any new claim-specific tool should require VerificationResult.

positives.finding: The six-digit OTP is generated and forwarded through ToolOutput with undisclosed typing rather than relying on guidelines to hide it.
positives.evidence: SecurityCodeValue undisclosed:true; generate_security_code outputInstructions tell the model not to mention the code; guardrail blocks bypass attempts.
positives.fix: Keep backend validation authoritative; do not add guidelines that expose OTP handling.

positives.finding: Custom guardrails target adversarial customer inputs (social engineering, token extraction, amount promises) rather than normal tone rules.
positives.evidence: guardrails.custom[0–2] each begin with "Block attempts…" and align with social-engineering and amount-request scenarios.
positives.fix: Optional fourth guardrail for pasted documents/SSN if evals show conversational scope slips.

positives.finding: All twelve required fictional claim-status personas are authored and grouped in osc-v1-scenarios.
positives.evidence: test-sets/osc-v1-scenarios.json lists linus-documents-required through sage-status-unavailable (12 IDs); mock-plan.json includes matching VerifyClaimIdentity/GetClaimSummary cases.
positives.fix: Run the set after publish; keep claim-id-recovery and other stage-2 cases in osc-v1-full for extended coverage.

changeSuggestions.text: Clear data-action capacity, create the seven mikedai_OSC_* integrations, and replace PENDING_CREATE target IDs before calling create_version.
Unify neutral verification-failure wording between verify_claim_identity and validate_security_code outputInstructions.
Dedupe verification micro-flow from global instructions; keep it on the verification tools only.
Harden create_service_case verification reporting (backend-derived or validated, not User-sourced enum).
Confirm MikeD_KB_Config corpus and run osc-v1-smoke then osc-v1-scenarios after build.

summary.prose: Design-only review: the verification type graph, undisclosed OTP/token types, and gated claim tools are strong and should satisfy the demo security story once integrations exist. Payload shape passes standard preflight checks; the sole publish blocker is placeholder data-action target IDs (compounded by org data-action cap). Instruction quality is generally empathetic and well aligned with test rubrics, but global guidelines repeat tool-local verification rules and slightly diverge on neutral failure wording for OTP retries. Guardrails are appropriately adversarial. All twelve required fictional scenarios are present locally with mocks planned; evaluation awaits build.
topPriorities: Replace PENDING_CREATE data action targets after org capacity is available
Align OTP/identity failure copy to stay neutral and non-revealing
Reduce duplicated verification instructions in global guidelines
Derive handoff verification state from typed tokens, not User enum
Confirm KB config and run osc-v1-scenarios post-build

gaps: Required 12/12 fictional personas are authored in osc-v1-scenarios; claim-id-recovery and seven other stage-2 scenarios exist only in osc-v1-full (acceptable).
No eval runs yet (NOT_RUN); mocks in mock-plan.json are not bound in org.
Consider adding osc-v1-scenarios case for claim-id-recovery to the required-12 set if product owners treat ID recovery as mandatory.
